heroLead: Nixon is a small unincorporated community in Butler County, quiet enough that a lot of residents may not realize how much Marcellus leasing has touched the townships around it over the past fifteen years.
intro: Butler County's wet-gas Marcellus window reaches into this part of the county, and operators have worked steadily through the surrounding townships, pooling small legacy tracts into larger horizontal units along the way. If your family holds land near Nixon, or inherited a fractional interest from a relative's farm, that history is likely part of why your interest looks the way it does today.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Nixon directly. We do the title research ourselves and give you a plain explanation of what we find before making an offer.

sections.heading: Small Community, Real Marcellus Activity
paragraphs: Butler County doesn't draw the same attention as Washington or Greene counties, but it's been part of steady Marcellus development for over a decade, including the area around Nixon. As wet-gas territory, production here carries liquids revenue alongside methane, and processing costs for those liquids show up as deductions on your royalty statement.
If a horizontal unit reaches under your family's tract without a well pad actually sitting on it, that's standard for this kind of development and doesn't mean your interest isn't real.

sections.heading: Tracing Title Through Butler County Records
paragraphs: We research your chain of title through the Butler County Recorder of Deeds, confirming exactly how your interest was created, whether through a lease you signed or through inheritance from a family member.
Rural Butler County tracts near Nixon sometimes have title histories that take some digging to fully reconcile, and we do that work carefully before discussing terms.

sections.heading: Reading Your Royalty Statement Honestly
paragraphs: We'll go through your division order and any royalty statements with you so you understand your decimal interest and what's being deducted, in plain terms, before we ever talk value.

faqs.question: There's no well pad on my land near Nixon. Can my interest still be worth something?
faqs.answer: Yes. Horizontal units regularly pull in acreage from tracts without a pad on them directly. If your land was pooled into an active unit, your interest can carry real value.

faqs.question: My interest was inherited and I don't have much paperwork. Can you still help?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle most of the title research ourselves through county records, so incomplete family paperwork isn't a barrier to getting started.

faqs.question: How fast can a sale close once we agree on terms?
faqs.answer: Straightforward transfers with clear title typically close within a few weeks. We'll tell you upfront if anything about your specific situation will take longer.
